parsed.post: Discarding DEPTH=12 (0.9849) as it regressed from my DEPTH=10 best (0.9746). It seems the increased capacity is consuming too much budget per step, leading to under-training. Reverting to DEPTH=10. Next, I'll test lowering MATRIX_LR to 0.04 to see if we can stabilize even further.
parsed.description: Reverting to DEPTH=10 after DEPTH=12 failed to improve val_bpb. Testing a slightly lower learning rate (0.04) to see if it aids convergence at this depth.
